description: Compensation (make-up classes). Every ASSIGNED or UNCOVERED substitution from a leave creates a Compensation record owed by the ABSENT teacher (same subject and class, one per substituted period; a lab block = one periods=2 record on a consecutive pair, else two single records). An auto-suggestion engine (services/compensation.py) proposes a concrete future slot; HOD/teacher confirm, reschedule, complete, cancel via /api/compensations; new Compensations page; make-up cells in the Adjusted timetable; backfill endpoint for old substitutions. Independent of FEAT-001/002 (reuses services/schedule_utils.py from FEAT-001, dateUtils.js). Full rules in .agents/tasks/plan.md (Decisions 5-13) - read it. Use TimetableEntry.is_double (not Subject.is_lab) as the lab signal. Never delete the existing leaves/substitutions.
steps: MODEL: re-read backend/app/models.py; add CompensationStatus(str, enum.Enum) PROPOSED/SCHEDULED/COMPLETED/CANCELLED and class Compensation (__tablename__ 'compensations'): id; leave_id FK leaves nullable index; substitution_id FK substitutions nullable index; substitution2_id FK nullable; teacher_id FK index; subject_id FK; class_section_id FK; is_lab bool; missed_date Date index; missed_time_slot_id FK; missed_time_slot2_id FK nullable; periods int; proposed_date Date nullable index; proposed_time_slot_id FK nullable; proposed_time_slot2_id FK nullable; room_id FK rooms nullable; status Enum default PROPOSED index; notes String(600) nullable; created_at, updated_at DateTime default utcnow. Relationships teacher, subject, class_section, room, missed_time_slot, missed_time_slot2, proposed_time_slot, proposed_time_slot2 with explicit foreign_keys. Tables are auto-created on startup.

SCHEMAS: re-read backend/app/schemas.py; add CompensationOut (id, leave_id, substitution_id, teacher_id, teacher, subject, class_section, class_section_id, is_lab, missed_date, missed_period (e.g. 'P3-P4 08:30-09:25'), missed_day_of_week, periods, proposed_date|None, proposed_day_of_week|None, proposed_period label|None, proposed_start_time, proposed_end_time, proposed_time_slot_id, proposed_time_slot2_id, room, room_id, status, notes, created_at, can_complete:bool), CompensationSlotRequest(date, time_slot_id, time_slot2_id|None, room_id|None), CompensationSuggestionOut(date, day_name, time_slot_id, time_slot2_id|None, period_label, start_time, end_time, room_id, room, week_offset:int, teacher_load_that_day:int, reason:str), CompensationSummary(owed:int [PROPOSED+SCHEDULED periods], proposed, scheduled, completed, cancelled counts), BackfillResult(created:int, periods:int, skipped:int), CompensationCalendarItem(id, teacher_id, teacher, class_section_id, class_section, subject, date, day_of_week, period_indexes:list[int], periods:int, room, status, is_lab).

SERVICE: create backend/app/services/compensation.py (module docstring, from __future__ import annotations). Reuse _window_slot_ids from app.services.timetable_generator, slot_minutes from schedule_utils, settings.max_consecutive_periods. Functions: _check_candidate (date > missed_date, date >= today, weekday <= 5, teacher active, no ACTIVE Leave for teacher on that date of any scope, slot(s) in the class time_window MORNING/AFTERNOON, lab record needs two slots on same day with period_index diff 1, teacher free of base entries as teacher/co_teacher + ASSIGNED substitutions as substitute that date + other PROPOSED/SCHEDULED comps that date (exclude self), declared Availability respected, day load incl. candidate <= max_periods_per_day, longest run of consecutive ordinal slots <= max_consecutive_periods, class free of base entries and other comps, room free at all slots and room.is_lab == comp.is_lab); suggest_slots(db, comp, limit=12) enumerating anchor week = week of max(missed_date, today), week offsets 0,1,2, sorted by (week_offset, date, teacher_periods_that_day, 0 if adjacent to an existing class and load_after <= max_consecutive else 1, period_index), preferring the missed entry's room then lowest id; validate_slot(db, comp, d, slot_id, slot2_id, room_id) -> (room_id, error reason or None) with no horizon cap; create_for_substitutions(db, subs, actor_id=None) idempotent (skip subs already referenced by any comp), group lab halves by (leave_id, block_id) into one periods=2 record, fall back to two single records if no consecutive pair is found, status PROPOSED with best slot or null + note 'No free slot found in the next 3 weeks', db.flush() after each record so later ones see reservations; ensure_for_substitution(db, sub); cancel_for_leave(db, leave, actor_id) (PROPOSED/SCHEDULED -> CANCELLED, notify teacher if it was SCHEDULED); handle_new_leave_conflicts(db, leave) (re-propose PROPOSED comps of that teacher on the leave date, notify HOD for SCHEDULED ones); backfill(db, actor_id) for ASSIGNED/UNCOVERED substitutions with no comp record of any status; sweep_past(db) (SCHEDULED with last date < today -> COMPLETED note 'Auto-completed'; PROPOSED with past date -> re-propose); active_comp_slots(db, d) -> {teacher_id: set(slot_ids)} for the substitution engine; to_out(comp) serializer. Notifications aggregated (one per teacher, one per HOD per operation) via notify(); audit.log actions COMP_PROPOSED, COMP_SCHEDULED, COMP_RESCHEDULED, COMP_COMPLETED, COMP_CANCELLED, COMP_BACKFILL with entity 'compensation'.

ROUTER: create backend/app/routers/compensations.py (prefix /api/compensations). Declare static routes before /{id}: GET '' (filters teacher_id, status comma list, on; teacher forced to own), GET /summary, GET /calendar?on= (all users, returns CompensationCalendarItem for PROPOSED/SCHEDULED/COMPLETED comps on that date; join proposed slots to period_index), POST /backfill (HOD). Then GET /{id}/suggestions, POST /{id}/confirm (optional CompensationSlotRequest body; PROPOSED only; validate chosen or proposed slot, 409 with reason if invalid), POST /{id}/reschedule (PROPOSED or SCHEDULED, body required, validated), POST /{id}/complete (SCHEDULED only, last date <= today), POST /{id}/cancel (HOD only), POST /{id}/repropose. Owner teacher or HOD may act (else 403) except cancel/backfill = HOD. sweep_past runs at the start of list/summary/calendar. Each mutation: audit.log, notify teacher + HODs, db.commit(). Register in backend/app/main.py (re-read first).

HOOKS (re-read each file first): backend/app/routers/leaves.py create_leave - after assign_substitutes_for_leave call compensation.handle_new_leave_conflicts then create_for_substitutions(db, subs, actor_id=current.id) before db.commit(); cancel_leave - call cancel_for_leave before commit; backend/app/routers/substitutions.py manual_assign - call ensure_for_substitution(db, sub) before commit; backend/app/services/substitution_engine.py _busy_slots_from_subs - union compensation.active_comp_slots(db, d) using a lazy import inside the function to avoid a circular import.
Restart the backend on 8010 and verify (see verification), including the backfill run once so the page has data. Remove throwaway test data afterwards.
